name: LOSTPEACE ~Ushinawareta Kakera~
source:
As a joke me and my friends summoned the dead and a real ghost actually appeared. Who was it? What was their purpose?
As the night went on we delved deeper into the mystery.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE088388.html]DLsite[/url]]
